title: Buck Banville and the cornet Louis Armstrong helped him get
summary: Eddie Hyman played with Buck Banville; Lala says Armstrong took him to the manufacturers who gave him a cornet, which Banville now has.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Yeah? Eddie? He played with Buck Banville. Yeah, he played with Buck Banville. Buck's my uncle.

Is that right? Yeah, Buck married my, Buck's got the cornet, the cornet he's got right now, they gave, made me a present, they grow a pretty cornet in Chicago. Louis Armstrong, cost me getting that cornet. Is that right? Louis Armstrong, he brought me up to the Arab EJ manufacturers.
And they made me a present for that cornet.
Louis Armstrong. Yeah, I knew he bought one when he went on the boat.
And Buck Banville got that cornet. I seen him at the Waco about a month ago. He said, Johnny, I still got the cornet.
I haven't seen him in a long time. He was playing piano. Yeah. Out at the Plum Plants. You know where it is.
